review.notes: Independent review by Claude (Opus 5.5), session claude-zm0UEa, issue #10238; this reviewer did none of the PrismaticCohomology packaging, fix or review jobs. Checked: exemplar form, sources (K1, KY, KYcorr, BLRH, MW20, Inoue, CK, SSV, CN21, BS22, DLLZ, KatoII read page by page; over 60 locators verified), supplier order (all suppliers in lower tiers or earlier in the tier-13 bundle; PadicHodgeTheory, CohomologyComparisons and HodgeTateAndCanonicalSubgroups only as consumers), duplication against current TauCetiRoadmap main, the Tau Ceti library, atlas supplier packages and Parts I-III.
